sam: Hey devex — quick repro: sample-app v0.7.1 fails JSON-mode schema validation when a tool returns an empty object. Node SDK emits something that Python SDK's strict schema rejects.

maria: repro steps?

sam: steps:
1) use node SDK, jsonMode: true, register tool 'get_user' returning {} sometimes
2) request -> SDK returns tool output in 'tool_calls' array with payload like:
```
{"tool_output": {},}
```
Note the extra trailing comma after empty object.

alex: ugh that's nasty. Is it definitely coming from node SDK serializer?

sam: yes. I instrumented and the join logic in stringifyUtils adds a trailing comma when array.item is empty string. Repro snippet:
```
// naive serializer
parts.push(JSON.stringify(obj))
if (maybeExtra) parts.push(',')
return parts.join('')
```

jen: what does python SDK receive? raw string?

sam: python gets the string and then json.loads blows up on trailing comma when validating against Pydantic schema (strict). The error is: `JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 17 (char 16)`

maria: temporary workaround for integrators?

alex: in sample app switched to a sanitize helper: `client.helpers.normalizeToolOutput(raw)` that strips trailing commas and empty tokens. Works.

sam: yes but it's not ideal. We should fix at source.

paul: filing bug + PR? can we hotfix patch in canary? @cli-bot create issue

cli-bot: Created issue INF-3487: "node-sdk/jsonmode: trailing comma when tool returns empty object -> parse failures in strict SDKs" assigned to @alex. Link: https://tracker/redwood/INF-3487

alex: will send patch. preliminary fix: guard push of comma only when next item exists. test added.

jen: can we add e2e that uses node+python combo and pydantic strict schema to catch regressions?

alex: yep adding cross-sdk e2e. ETA 24h for canary, 3 days for stable.

maria: leaving note in sample app docs: add `helpers.normalizeToolOutput` until patch lands :memo:

sam: thanks. saved our onboarding demo.

maria: follow-up: also check kv-cache serialization — might be similar edge-case.

alex: good call. I'll audit serializer.

sam: cc @eng-ml in case model-serving serializer does similar

eng-bot: Notifying eng-ml channel about INF-3487

sam: closing loop: after canary I'll re-run sample app and post logs here.
